subject: POC final readout & decision process - ZenWell Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenwell.health>, Linh Tran <linh.tran@zenwell.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps — Redwood POC plan / success criteria

Hi Amit / Linh —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap of what we agreed and next steps to get the POC moving into execution: 

1) Success criteria (ZenWell & Redwood):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for clinical triage flows (avg input length ~120 tokens).
- Cost: per-inference cost target <= $0.015 after batching/quantization recommendations.
- Quality: accuracy of intent classification >= 92% on your test set (we'll run the sample eval).
- Reliability: 99.5% uptime during business hours for the trial window.

2) Evaluation plan and ownership:
- ZenWell: provide a de-identified sample set (500 queries) + evaluation rubric by next Wed (Jun 30) — owner: Linh.
- Redwood: set up POC environment, deploy model variant (r-instruct-3b-quant) and run evaluation harness — owner: Marissa.
- Marcus (Ops): build KV/prefix cache and monitoring dashboards for token breakdowns — owner: Marcus.

3) Timelines:
- Data handoff: by 2026-06-30
- Initial environment ready & smoke test: 2026-07-06
- Full evaluation run: 2026-07-09 to 2026-07-15
- Final readout / exec review: week of 2026-07-20 (you mentioned 7/22 as preferred)

4) Next contractual step for production if go decision: standard Dedicated reservation quote + SOW. We'll prepare a draft and share prior to exec readout so procurement can review.

Attached: POC playbook and a draft success metrics workbook for your team to populate.

Please confirm owners and dates or propose adjustments. Happy to hop on a 15-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-poc-playbook.pdf; zenwell-poc-success-metrics.xlsx

From: Linh Tran <linh.tran@zenwell.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenwell.health>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Redwood POC plan / success criteria

Thanks Marissa — this is great and captures the conversation. Quick answers:

- Owner confirmed: I will send the de-identified sample set by Tue 6/30.
- Execs: Sarah Miller will join the final readout (she's looped in on procurement conversations).
- Regarding the cost target: procurement will want a sensitivity table (best/worst). Can Redwood add that to the final readout materials?

One ask from my side: can we include a short runbook for how our CS team can validate results (step-by-step) so our QA can reproduce evaluation? If you have a one-pager we can include in the playbook that'd be helpful.

Thanks — Linh
Linh Tran
Senior Product Manager, ZenWell Health
linh.tran@zenwell.health | (555) 212-9988

Hi all —

I'll own the dashboards and the cost sensitivity table. I'll produce:
- A cost sensitivity slide with batching/quantization scenarios (best/likely/worst).
- A monitoring dashboard link (shared to your team once ready).
- A short runbook (1 page) for ZenWell QA to reproduce evaluation steps.

ETA: cost sensitivity + runbook by 2026-07-07; dashboard shared after smoke test on 2026-07-06.

Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Redwood POC plan / success criteria

Sounds good. One procurement note: our legal team prefers a short POC agreement (2 pages) that clarifies data handling and IP for evaluation only. Can you share a template? Also, can we get a preliminary Dedicated pricing ballpark for the post-POC proposal?

Amit Shah
Head of Procurement, ZenWell Health
amit.shah@zenwell.health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenwell.health>, Linh Tran <linh.tran@zenwell.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Redwood POC plan / success criteria

Amit — thanks, noted.

1) POC agreement: attaching a short template for your legal team to review (POC-Agreement-ZenWell.docx). It limits use to evaluation data and includes a mutual NDA clause.
2) Dedicated pricing ballpark: Marcus — can you provide a 3-tier ballpark (S/M/L reserved capacity) for post-POC by EOD Wed 7/1 so Amit's team can review ahead of the exec readout?
3) Readout deck: I'll prepare the final readout slide deck and include Marcus' sensitivity table + runbook + our recommended next contract steps. I'll share the draft by 7/15 so you have time for procurement review.

If ZenWell is ok, we'll tentatively schedule the exec readout for Thu, 22 Jul 2026 at 10:00 AM PT. Confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: POC-Agreement-ZenWell.docx

From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@zenwell.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@zenwell.health>, Linh Tran <linh.tran@zenwell.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Redwood POC plan / success criteria

Marissa / team — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming:

- 7/22 at 10:00 AM PT works for the exec readout on our side.
- We'll expect the draft readout by 7/15 and the POC agreement for legal review this week.
- Decision process on 7/22: execs will assess the success criteria + cost sensitivity and provide a go/no-go. If go, procurement will advance to an S/M/L reserved capacity quote and targeted start date Q3.

One quick ask: can Redwood include an optional rollout plan (staging -> pilot -> prod) and an estimated timeline for each phase in the readout? That will help the execs see an implementation runway.

See you on the 22nd,
Sarah Miller
Chief Product Officer, ZenWell Health
